description: Defines classes and enums for managing cache rankings and LRU lists in disk cache, including Rankings class, RankCrashes enum, and related data structures.

classes.name: Rankings
classes.description: Manages cache ranking information, including multiple lists of cache entries, and provides methods for list manipulation, integrity checks, and iteration.

classes.name: ScopedRankingsBlock
classes.description: A specialized unique_ptr for CacheRankingsBlock that calls FreeRankingsBlock on deletion to manage cache ranking blocks safely.

classes.name: Rankings::Iterator
classes.description: Tracks current position in multiple cache ranking lists during iteration.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the Rankings object with backend and list counting options.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Restores the Rankings object to its initial state, ready for re-initialization.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a cache ranking node into a specified list.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a cache ranking node from a specified list, with strictness control.

methods.name: UpdateRank
methods.description: Moves a node to the head of its list, updating its rank.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Returns the next node in a specified list.

methods.name: GetPrev
methods.description: Returns the previous node in a specified list.

methods.name: FreeRankingsBlock
methods.description: Frees a cache rankings block, used internally.

methods.name: TrackRankingsBlock
methods.description: Starts or stops tracking a rankings block for iteration purposes.

methods.name: SelfCheck
methods.description: Performs integrity checks on the ranking lists.

methods.name: SanityCheck
methods.description: Checks if a node is properly linked within the list.

methods.name: DataSanityCheck
methods.description: Checks the validity of a node's data.

methods.name: SetContents
methods.description: Sets the address contents of a ranking node.
